answer_1.quote: We evaluate all models on both WEBNLG and WSJ using automatic and human evaluation experiments.

answer_2.quote: Metrics. Following ..., we evaluated REG systems from 3 angles. (1) RE Accuracy and String Edit Distance (SED) ... (2) After adding the REs to the original document, BLEU and Text Accuracy were used to evaluate the output text. (3) Precision, recall, and F1 score were used to assess pronominalisation.

answer_4.quote: We used Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) for human evaluation. Participants were asked to rate each text for its fluency, grammaticality and clarity on a 7-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each generated text on fluency, grammaticality, and clarity using a 7-point Likert scale.
